set.input.throttleStyle.help: Stick in the centre (camera drone): the left stick springs to the centre: centre holds the height, up climbs, down descends. Let go and the drone stops and hovers. The motors start when you move a stick. From zero (FPV): as FPV pilots fly: the motors start (this is called arming) only with the left stick all the way down, and the stick sets the motors' power. Automatic chooses by where your stick rests. Saved for each controller; J switches it. Touch and the keyboard always fly without arming.
keys.throttle.style: Left stick: in the centre (camera drone) or from zero (FPV)
throttle.afterLanding: Left stick: {style} after landing (the motors are running now)
throttle.radioOnly: This is for a radio or a gamepad. Touch and the keyboard already fly without arming (the motors start by themselves).
throttle.about.centred: The left stick springs to the centre: centre holds the height, up climbs, down descends. Let go and the drone stops and hovers. The motors start when you move a stick.
throttle.about.zero: As FPV pilots fly: the motors start (this is called arming) only with the left stick all the way down, and the stick sets the motors' power.
throttle.why.centre: Chosen automatically: your left stick rests in the centre.
throttle.why.bottom: Chosen automatically: your left stick rests at the bottom.
throttle.why.parked: Chosen automatically: your left stick rests between the bottom and the centre.
throttle.why.table: Chosen automatically: this controller's left stick springs back to the centre.
throttle.offer.rest: Your left stick is resting in the centre, so the motors cannot start the FPV way.
throttle.offer.fpv: To fly like FPV, lower the left stick all the way down, then press your controller's start/stop button or flip its arm switch: that starts the motors (this is called arming).
throttle.offer.button: Fly with the stick in the centre
throttle.offer.keys: Or press {src} on your controller, or J on the keyboard.
throttle.offer.keysOnly: Or press J on the keyboard.
throttle.acro: Acro: the left stick sets the motors' power directly, the centre is half power. The height is held only in angle and horizon.
throttle.card.centred: Stick in the centre (camera drone): no arming needed. Push the left stick up to climb, down to descend, let go to hover. The motors start when you move a stick.
